decision.statement: Launch a fixed-price managed-outcomes pilot for mid-market software buyers at premium pricing in Q1 2027.
decision.pricing: 20 percent premium to comparable marketplace contracts

criteria.condition: At least two external actors profitably replicate the managed offering within two moves
criteria.observable: Number of competing managed offerings with positive contribution margin
criteria.threshold: At least two profitable competing offerings

criteria.condition: Delivery guarantees drive the home pilot contribution margin below ten percent
criteria.observable: Home managed-outcomes contribution margin after guarantee costs

criteria.condition: Competitive exclusivity deals leave fewer than fifteen qualified home delivery teams
criteria.observable: Available qualified teams for the home pilot

board.evidence_status: Fictional teaching assumptions; not claims about actual companies
